sections.title: Strategy rules
items: On every monthly option expiration day (the third Friday, or the last exchange session before it when the exchange is closed), at 09:30 New York, sell short at the open of the 09:30 bar.
Exit at the open of the 10:30 New York bar.

sections.title: Strategy rules
items: On every monthly option expiration day (the third Friday, or the last exchange session before it when the exchange is closed), at 09:30 New York, place a Sell Stop 0.025 volatility units below the 09:30 open; it fills once price trades down through that level before 10:30, otherwise the signal is skipped.
Exit at the open of the 10:30 New York bar.

sections.title: Strategy rules
items: On every monthly option expiration day (the third Friday, or the last exchange session before it when the exchange is closed), at 09:30 New York, place a Sell Stop 0.025 volatility units below the 09:30 open; it fills once price trades down through that level before 10:30, otherwise the signal is skipped.
Exit at the open of the 10:30 New York bar; a stop loss 0.73 volatility units above the fill.

sections.title: Strategy rules
items: On every monthly option expiration day (the third Friday, or the last exchange session before it when the exchange is closed), at 09:30 New York, place a Sell Stop 0.025 volatility units below the 09:30 open; it fills once price trades down through that level before 10:30, otherwise the signal is skipped.
Exit at the open of the 10:30 New York bar; a stop loss 0.73 volatility units above the fill; a take profit 0.165 volatility units below the fill.
